title: Checking on a Coworker After Surgery
script: Tia: [reflective] Bagus, hi! I heard your surgery went well yesterday. How are you feeling today?
Bagus: Hi Tia, thanks for calling. Honestly, sore and groggy, although the doctor says everything went as planned.
Tia: [thoughtful] That's such good news. I was worried all morning, since you seemed nervous about it last week.
Bagus: I was terrified, actually, more than I let anyone see, although the anesthesia made the actual moment disappear completely.
Tia: [tired] That's understandable. Appendix surgery isn't small, even though doctors treat it as fairly routine these days.
Bagus: My discharge instructions restrict heavy lifting for now, and follow-up will guide my return to work.
Tia: [honestly] Don't worry about work at all. With your permission, I gave our manager only the work update you approved.
Bagus: Thank you, Tia, honestly. I was already stressing about my project deadline before you called.
Tia: [gently] Stressing about deadlines is exactly what your body doesn't need right now, so please just rest.
Bagus: Easier said than done. I've never been good at sitting still for long, even when I clearly should.
Tia: [hopeful] I remember. You answered emails from a hospital bed once, after your last minor procedure.
Bagus: That's true, although laughing right now actually hurts my stitches, so please stop being funny.
Tia: [relieved] Sorry, sorry. Is someone staying with you this week, or are you managing completely alone?
Bagus: My mother arrived this morning. She's already cooking more food than I could possibly eat in a month.
Tia: [grateful] That sounds perfect, honestly. Family support helps most when it follows the discharge instructions and asks what the patient needs.
Bagus: She does. Although she also keeps reminding me to rest, which I clearly needed to hear from someone.
Tia: [carefully] Listen carefully to her, then. Do you need anything from outside, groceries or anything else useful?
Bagus: That's kind of you to offer, but honestly, between my mother and the neighbors, I'm well taken care of.
Tia: [warmly] Good. Just focus on healing properly, and call me if that changes even slightly during the week.
Bagus: I will. Thank you for checking on me, Tia. It genuinely means more than you probably realize.

quiz.question: What surgery did Bagus have?
quiz.explanation: Tia mentions it isn't small, even though doctors treat appendix surgery as fairly routine these days.

quiz.question: How long does the nurse say Bagus needs before lifting anything heavy?
quiz.explanation: The nurse said he'll need about two weeks before he can lift anything heavy or return to work fully.

quiz.question: What did Tia already do for Bagus regarding work?
options: Told their manager he needs proper time to recover
Asked him to work from the hospital
quiz.explanation: Tia already told their manager that Bagus will need proper time to recover.

quiz.question: Who is staying with Bagus this week?
quiz.explanation: His mother arrived that morning and is cooking food for him while he recovers.

quiz.question: What does Tia offer to do for Bagus?
options: Get groceries or anything useful from outside
quiz.explanation: Tia offers to bring groceries or anything else useful, though Bagus says he is already well taken care of.

quiz.question: How did Tia learn what could be shared with work?
options: She told the manager without asking
Bagus gave permission for a limited update

quiz.question: What controls lifting and return-to-work timing?
options: A fixed two weeks for everyone

quiz.question: Why should Bagus avoid working from bed?
options: Rest and a clear handover are more useful than weak participation
The manager removed him from the team
quiz.explanation: The advice follows the recovery plan rather than proving commitment.

quiz.question: What is the mother’s appropriate role?
options: Practical support that follows medical instructions
Knowing automatically what the body needs
quiz.explanation: Family care supports, but does not replace, the health team.

quiz.question: How does Tia offer help respectfully?
options: She asks what is useful and accepts that current support is enough
quiz.explanation: The patient can accept, decline, or update the request.
